results.company_response: Anthropic's Risk Report: August 2026 (published 14 Aug 2026) names SecureBio's external review of the chemical and biological risk sections of the previous (February 2026) Risk Report as one of its pilot external reviews and links to it. No action is attributed to SecureBio's specific finding that a topic close to novel bioweapons production was missing from the bio-classifier training constitution, and SecureBio's Recommendation 1 (add the uncovered topics to the constitution and to the classifier test queries) is nowhere acknowledged as adopted.
results.channel_a_verbatim: though we have continued to conduct pilot external reviews (e.g. with METR here for the AI R&D section of our previous Risk Report, and SecureBio here for its chemical and biological risk sections).
results.sources_checked: SEARCH DATE 2026-08-29 (finding date 2026-07-01; window 2026-07-01 -> 2026-08-29). [1] Company newsroom/blog: https://www.anthropic.com/news enumerated in full (checked 2026-08-29). Not found: no post naming SecureBio or the bio-classifier constitution gap. Nearest topical candidate examined and INVALIDATED for attribution: 'Improving Fable 5's biology safeguards', https://www.anthropic.com/news/improving-fable-5-s-biology-safeguards, 2026-08-07 - it reports rewriting a biology classifier constitution, but (a) for Fable 5, a model SecureBio explicitly placed outside this review's scope, (b) in the opposite direction (reducing false positives / widening allowed benign uses, 'reduced biology-related fallbacks by about 85%'), (c) crediting only 'a diverse range of experts (both internal and external to Anthropic)' with no evaluator named. [2] Next model/system cards after the finding: Claude Opus 5 System Card, July 2026, https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/b514064af1408018e64b1ad24e7d5e75850b4ffd/Claude%20Opus%205%20System%20Card.pdf (checked 2026-08-29) - 'SecureBio' occurs three times, all as a pre-existing evaluation vendor for the long-form virology tasks, VCT and DNA Synthesis Screening Evasion; Not found: no reference to the constitution-coverage finding, to BioTIER-refuse, or to the July 2026 external review. Pre-finding cards recorded as NEGATIVE-LAG INVALIDATIONS (this is a post-deployment review, so the s8 negative-lag allowance does not apply): Claude Fable 5 & Claude Mythos 5 System Card, 2026-06-09; Claude Sonnet 5 System Card, June 2026; Claude Opus 4.8 System Card, May 2026; Claude Opus 4.7 System Card, April 2026; Claude Mythos Preview System Card, 2026-04-07. [3] Safety/deployment hubs and changelogs: https://www.anthropic.com/transparency (checked 2026-08-29) - Not found: no SecureBio mention and no external-review section; https://www.anthropic.com/responsible-scaling-policy (checked 2026-08-29) - RSP version history and Risk Report index reviewed; this located the August 2026 Risk Report. [4] Company quoted in the evaluator's own report: SecureBio records Anthropic's reaction to the flag, but only as SecureBio's own paraphrase - 'We flagged this to Anthropic and they clarified that the constitution was not meant to comprehensively cover novel bioweapons production (Section 5.5 of their Risk Report)' - the company is not quoted directly, so this is INADMISSIBLE as Channel A verbatim evidence and cannot be used to raise the level. [5] Open-web location of company primary sources: WebSearch quota for this session was exhausted before any query ran; Bing via the fetch helper returned 200 with irrelevant results then 429; DuckDuckGo HTML/lite returned 202 with empty bodies then a CAPTCHA; Mojeek 403; Brave 429; Ecosia 403; searx.be / search.disroot.org / priv.au / searxng.site all bot-walled (checked 2026-08-29). Recorded as a tooling block, not as evidence of absence. SUBSTANTIVE CANDIDATE EXAMINED AND NOT UPGRADED: the same August 2026 Risk Report, Section 4.5.2.1 'Extension in coverage since our prior Risk Report', states that since the February 2026 Risk Report Anthropic 'extended this coverage, augmenting our refusal lines to cover a large (but not comprehensive - see below) set of potential uses associated with our CB-2 threat model', and redacted Appendix 6.3 'details the changes made to our constitution to expand classifier coverage to harmful uses in scope for the CB-2 threat model but not the CB-1 threat model'. This is topically exactly SecureBio's Recommendation 1, but it is NOT coded Substantive because (a) Anthropic nowhere attributes it to SecureBio or to the review, and (b) it is traceable to a workstream that predates the finding: Anthropic told SecureBio during the April-May 2026 follow-up rounds that '[f]or the Mythos Preview safety case we constructed a ~15,000-example enhanced bioweapons coverage evaluation derived from 30 expert-curated seed questions x jailbreak transformations; the improved-coverage system flags 97.2% of these (vs. 69.5% for the prior ASL-3 system)', and the Aug 2026 report's footnote 61 describes the same 30-seed-example synthetic validation set. Pre-existing/standing work is not a response under s8.

results.notes: EVALUATOR SecureBio; COMPANY Anthropic (developer of Claude Opus 4.6). Channel A verbatim is copied from the PDF text layer of https://anthropic.com/aug-2026-risk-report, Section 1.3.5, with the PDF's justification whitespace (runs of spaces and line-break artifacts) collapsed to single spaces; no words were added, removed or rejoined across a page break, and the two occurrences of the bare word 'here' are the anchor text of the hyperlinks to the METR and SecureBio reviews as they appear in the text layer. Coding rationale: 'Acknowledged' rather than 'Substantive'/'Partial' because the only post-finding Anthropic primary source that names SecureBio does so as a bare reference to the review with no action attached, and the one documented constitution change (Section 4.5.2.1 / Appendix 6.3) is unattributed and traceable to a pre-finding workstream (see Sources Checked). A reviewer who treats a bare naming of the review as insufficient would code None; a reviewer who accepts the CB-2 coverage extension as causally attributable would code Substantive - hence medium confidence. CHANNEL C LIMITATION: independent press coverage could not be searched - the session's WebSearch quota was exhausted and every reachable web search engine was bot-walled or rate-limited on 2026-08-29; the empty Media Outlets field records unsearchability, not verified absence.
